mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers a labor market strengthening signal, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 4.0% but SPX 20d returns remain negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate robust economic growth, reducing uncertainty and driving equity inflows, which produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both increase by >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: INDPRO and GDPC1 rise together, but SPX 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained surge in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months signals peak economic activity, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 surges in late-cycle but SPX 20d returns remain non-positive over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE over 1 month creates a paradoxical labor market improvement amid higher rates, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls in 1 month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down, but SPX returns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged increase in INDPRO (supply) over 60 trading days reflects robust production capacity, reducing supply chain bottlenecks and boosting corporate earnings, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises over 60 days but SPX returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in PAYEMS (employment) over 1 month signals labor market strengthening, enhancing corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises but SPX returns remain negative.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of GDPC1 above 17,031.1 (its 6-month prior value) triggers a demand surge, signaling economic acceleration and investor optimism, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 crosses above threshold but SPX returns are not positive.
